subject: general
question: The intersection point of the medians of a triangle is called:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06c3a0d1b8cf316d21ab5c29005bf841bb0658edecc25becb3dc380d40a00240.png] 

**The intersection point of the medians of a triangle is called the centroid.**
